title: Optical characteristics after Descemet membrane endothelial keratoplasty: 1-year results

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: 'distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License', ext-link http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

indication: Pseudophakic eyes with stromal edema and without stromal scarring: pseudophakic bullous keratopathy 21, Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy 9 (Table 1); phakic or triple DMEK, DMEK for failed PKP, amblyopia, glaucoma and macular disease excluded; all eyes had preoperative epithelial bullae or microcystic changes

groups.description: DMEK by a single surgeon, Yokohama Minami Kyosai Hospital, July 2017 to March 2018: descemetorhexis of about 9.0 mm under air, under-sized pre-stripped CorneaGen grafts (7.75, 8.0 or 8.25 mm) inserted with an IOL inserter (WJ-60M), unfolded and fixed with 20% SF6 (80% fill); epithelial debridement for erosion or bullae; rebubbling for large progressive detachments (2 eyes within 2 weeks); 30 eyes of 30 patients

exclusions.what: Table 2 column 'Control eyes' (31 age-matched phakic healthy eyes without ocular surgery)
exclusions.reason: Healthy unoperated control eyes are not admissible

exclusions.what: Table 2 column 'P-Value' and Table 2 BCVA block; Table 3 keratometric values; aberration data (Fig 1, S1 File)
exclusions.reason: p-values are not admissible; other quantities are not corneal thickness
Not part of the extraction inputs (article JATS XML only) and not acquired; may contain per-eye values

notes: Role: standard DMEK without an investigational agent; single control-role group (the healthy comparison eyes are excluded).
Prospective study; 30 DMEK eyes of 30 patients compared with 31 healthy controls; Japanese patients only.

Flagged for review: the article lists a supplementary dataset (S2 Table, XLSX) that may hold per-eye values. The protocol prefers per-eye rows over group means when they exist; it was not acquired under the article-XML-only brief, so the Table 2 group means are used.

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of the DMEK eyes (Table 2 block 'CCT (μm) (mean ± SD)', row 'Preoperative', column 'DMEK eyes'); AS-OCT (CASIA, Tomey)
series.notes: Table 2 rows Preoperative and Post-op month 1, 3, 6, 12, column 'DMEK eyes'; mean ± SD in µm; CCT by anterior segment OCT (CASIA) per Methods; per-visit n not tabulated (30 patients followed throughout, Results)
